approvalEvidence: Пользователь утвердил встраивание показанного набора FIELD-004…010 после замены FIELD-010 на закатный вариант: «Хорошо, можно встраивать.» (2026-09-27).
prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: Survival Arena FIELD-010 field-selection thumbnail. Input image: the supplied FIELD-010 candidate is the edit target. Primary request: change only the time of day, lighting, atmosphere, and color palette to a dramatic warm celestial sunset. Lighting/mood: low amber sun near the horizon; peach, coral, rose, and muted magenta clouds; rich amber-gold highlights on white stone and gilded architecture; long soft violet and deep blue shadows; majestic serene finale with a slightly ominous dusk undertone. Color palette: warm ivory stone, burnt gold, peach-orange sky, rose clouds, lavender-violet shadow, deep navy banner accents. Constraints: preserve the exact architecture, camera angle, framing, pathways, platforms, columns, bridges, banners, vegetation, cloud geometry, and all object placement; do not redesign or add structures; retain the hand-drawn storybook cutout rendering and clear 3/4 top-down gameplay readability; keep highlights controlled so paths remain readable; no characters, angels, creatures, text, logos, watermark. Avoid: daytime blue-sky palette, pale white washout, night scene, red inferno, fire, lava, storm, silhouette-only foreground.
